en.headline: Eight pupils sent to hospital after school bus hits taxi in Tin Shui Wai
en.dek: A nanny van carrying Tin Shui Wai Government Primary School pupils collided with a taxi on Tin Shui Road near Tin Chak Estate; all injuries were reported as minor.
body: Eight schoolchildren were taken to hospital on Wednesday morning after a school bus collided with a taxi outside Tin Chak Estate in Tin Shui Wai.

Police and local reports said the collision occurred at about 9.05am on Tin Shui Road. A taxi is understood to have overtaken the bus and stopped abruptly, causing the school vehicle to strike its rear and sustain damage to the front left side.

The bus was carrying pupils from Tin Shui Wai Government Primary School. The driver did not report the incident immediately and arranged a second vehicle to take the children to school. Staff later called for ambulances after several pupils reported feeling unwell.
Paramedics examined the children on site. None had visible injuries, but all eight were taken to Tin Shui Wai Hospital as a precaution. Police are investigating the cause of the accident.

zh.headline: 天水圍校巴與的士相撞 八學童不適送院
zh.dek: 天水圍官立小學保母車今早在天瑞路與的士輕微碰撞，八名學童其後表示不適，全部送往天水圍醫院檢查，傷勢輕微。
body: 天水圍今早發生校巴與的士相撞事故，八名學童其後表示不適，全部送往天水圍醫院治理。
警方及本地報道指，事發於約上午9時05分，地點在天瑞路近天澤邨。涉事保母車載有天水圍官立小學學童，懷疑的士爬頭後急停上客，導致保母車撞及的士車尾，左邊車頭損毀。
司機未有即時報警，安排另一輛保母車將學童送返學校。其後有學童表示不適，校方召救護車到場。救護員檢查後，八名學童均無明顯外傷，但仍全部送院作預防性檢查。
